guarded.EN: I hear you. Not now.

neutral.EN: Tensions are high. Let's table this for later.

warm.EN: Don't let the stress tear us apart. We're partners.

warm.EN: Let's take a second to reset. We're on the same side.

warm.EN: Breathe with me. We'll work through this disagreement later.
warm.TL: Sumabay kang huminga sa akin. Aayusin natin ito mamaya.

warm.EN: I'm not fighting you. Let's keep each other alive.

warm.EN: Stress is talking right now. Let's be gentle on each other.

guarded.EN: I won't let friendship blind me to a bad risk.
guarded.TL: Hindi ko hahayaang bulagin ng samahan ang maling sugal.

guarded.EN: We're close, but on this, you're dead wrong.
guarded.TL: Malapit tayo, pero rito, maling-mali ka.

neutral.EN: I trust your judgment usually, but not on this.

neutral.EN: We've earned the right to speak plainly: I disagree.

neutral.EN: You're one of the best survivors I know, but I disagree.

neutral.EN: Let's examine the facts together. Something doesn't add up.

neutral.EN: I respect you too much to nod along when you're wrong.

neutral.EN: We see this from two different angles.
neutral.TL: Nakikita natin ito mula sa dalawang magkaibang anggulo.

neutral.EN: Hear me out before you lock in your stance.
neutral.TL: Pakinggan mo muna ako bago mo isara ang isip mo.

neutral.EN: We have solid trust, so let's weigh the risks properly.
neutral.TL: Matibay ang tiwala natin, kaya timbangin natin ang panganib.

warm.EN: You know I'd follow you through hell, but not into this.

warm.EN: I love how bold you are, but this risk is too steep.
warm.TL: Hanga ako sa tapang mo, pero masyadong mataas ang sugal na ito.

warm.EN: Because I care about you, I have to say no to this.

warm.EN: We've kept each other alive this long. Trust me on this disagreement.

warm.EN: You're my closest ally, so listen to my gut on this one.

warm.EN: No matter what happens, we're solid. But I disagree here.

warm.EN: Let's find a compromise that keeps both of us safe.
warm.TL: Humanap tayo ng paraan na magpapanatiling ligtas sa ating dalawa.

warm.EN: I value our bond above any single disagreement.
warm.TL: Mas mahalaga ang samahan natin kaysa sa anumang pagtatalo.

warm.EN: We'll work it out together like we always do.

guarded.EN: Let's leave it there.

guarded.EN: I'm not arguing with you anymore.

guarded.EN: Done talking about this.

guarded.EN: I've said my piece. Leave it alone.

guarded.EN: Nothing more to say.

guarded.EN: We're done here.

guarded.EN: Walk away.

guarded.EN: I'm finished with this conversation.

neutral.EN: All right. Let's step back from this.

neutral.EN: We're not getting anywhere. Let's move on.

neutral.EN: Let's take a break from this topic.

neutral.EN: Fair enough. Let's focus on other priorities.

neutral.EN: No point spinning our wheels. Let's work.

neutral.EN: Understood. We'll leave it at that.

neutral.EN: Agreed. Moving past it now.
neutral.TL: Sang-ayon. Lumilipas na tayo roon.

neutral.EN: We can revisit this when things settle down.
neutral.TL: Mababalikan natin ito kapag maayos na ang lahat.

neutral.EN: All right. Let's put our energy elsewhere.

warm.EN: Let's leave it there for now, friend. We're still good.

warm.EN: It's all right. We can let this one slide.

warm.EN: I value our partnership too much to push this.

warm.EN: We'll be okay. Let's take a breather.
